scope: Environment-only edits; canonical Defdef never generated or edited

steps.name: initial material/input study
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: isolated V2.4 Signal Loom environment-only visual refinement.
Input 1 is the environment EDIT TARGET (1672×941). Input 2 is a placement reference showing the unchanged canonical Defdef at the station; DO NOT include the creature, text, headers, page UI or any crown in the output.
Preserve camera, platform footprint, scale, diagonal monumental signal transport and quiet left reading space. Output same wide dimensions.
Resolve these specific blockers:
1. Dark neutral silhouette field. In native image coordinates x1060–1380,y300–685, particularly directly behind the future mane/head/crown, reduce violet brightness and saturation by roughly 35–40%. Make those near facets dark charcoal-purple with restrained precise edge light; retain depth and distant violet transport. Remove the brightest vertical violet stripe behind the head. No aura, halo, vignette around an imaginary creature. Tone down the platform's broad pink reflection; keep localized edge reflection, a materially credible floor and a clear plane for feet at y682.
2. Idle physical input. The future canonical long nail on the viewer's LEFT terminates near native x1184,y607. Create a small but legible tangible machined bronze socket/control receiver at x1184,y615, upper rim near y608, mounted on a short dark composite pedestal reaching from the platform floor to the existing claw height. It should receive the nail later, without requiring changed anatomy. Socket top ellipse about 35×12 native pixels, restrained violet interior glow, recognizable hardware with a rim and body, not a detached dot or magic sparkle.
3. Route ONE continuous physical bronze-gold conductor from the existing broken red digital seam on upper right, down the existing right-side architecture, then along the operator bay's floor/rear lip into that left-hand receiver. Make the last branch visible on the floor and on the short receiver riser, going behind the future body where physically appropriate. Do not place its bright vertical run behind the future crown: move its lower vertical stretch to x1430–1500 on the viewer's right. Conductor is idle dark warm METAL, not luminous gold yet. No floating line, dotted SVG, crown stamp or HUD.
4. Replace the remaining mid-left aqueduct arches with flat engineered spans and sparse angular trusses. Reduce the little jagged black shard forest. Preserve monumental mysterious techno-mythic spatial depth; no castle, church or generic fantasy fortress.
Digital seam remains recessed voxel packets with red light on adjoining facets and architectural occlusion. Match the canonical medium through precise illustration edges and planar shading, without adding the character. Preserve all layout needed for the existing crop and full character. No text, logos, characters or watermark.

steps.name: receiver placement correction
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the environment-only EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the fixed-placement reference with canonical character: do NOT copy the character or text/UI to the output.
Keep every camera, structure, channel, platform and darkened silhouette field exactly unchanged. One correction only: MOVE the newly added bronze socket pedestal (currently center x984,y620 with rim at y590 in the 1672×941 environment) 200 image pixels to the RIGHT and 18 pixels DOWN. Its new rim must be centered x1184,y608. That is beneath the existing character's signature claw in reference 2. Keep same small machined hardware style, but make the socket rim 35px wide rather than its current ~65px width. Height to platform floor about65px. Remove the socket at its old location and restore floor there. Reroute the existing continuous physical bronze conductor along the rear floor to meet the base of the relocated receiver, then up its pedestal. The receiver will later be in front of the character's left paw; do not put it at the platform's far left edge again. NO creature, character, crown, labels or UI. Full original wide environment only, same dimensions. This is a placement correction, not a new composition.

steps.name: gold acknowledgment
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is EDIT TARGET, an environment-only Signal Loom idle refinement. Input 2 is character placement reference from the V2.4 composite. DO NOT include a creature, crown, silhouette, text or UI in the output. Same camera, geometry, platform, floor and dimensions.
Create ACKNOWLEDGMENT, changing only the signal mechanism:
- Red corrupted packet seam upper right locally aligns into small orderly amber-gold packets, leaving localized red residual packets at the very top.
- Light the PHYSICAL outer-right bronze conductor from that seam down the outside right side of the platform, then the floor branch returning into the claw receiver (the new small bronze cup around x1316,y600). Light that receiver's inset and nearby floor reflection warm pale gold. Preserve its position exactly. It is hardware, not a floating icon.
- The inner-left vertical conductor behind the future crown (roughly x1250–1390,y270–480) must stay dim dark bronze so the canonical crown has an uncluttered dark backdrop. The glowing return takes the outer-right physical run; do not create a bright wall behind the head.
- Add a small physical selector socket at the already existing right rail of the platform, rim near x1483,y522: a narrow vertical bronze stem rising from the right-hand rail/terminal at x1490,y635 to the pointing fingertip height, with a compact mechanical receiver around x1483,y522, about25 native pixels across. This is a second selector on the same connected operator bay, near the canonical pointing hand in reference 2. Keep its warm light restrained. Do not add decorative HUD or a magical beacon. Character anatomy and pose are unchanged because character will be composited separately.
Everything else stays unchanged, including darker violet silhouette field, engineered trusses, broken-signal spatial depth, quiet text space, and scale. Light and reflection belong to actual conductor material. No bright global gold wash; no new left background or distant architecture.

steps.name: selector height correction
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Single tiny correction to the supplied environment image. Keep ALL other pixels, camera, lighting, receiver cup, platform and architecture unchanged.
The only edit target is the small circular gold selector on a thin upright stem at the lower right of the operator bay (currently approximately x1476,y565). Raise this same circular receiver head UP by 54 native image pixels, to center x1476,y511. Keep its width and circular face unchanged, around25px. The bottom of the stem stays fixed on the existing right platform rail at y660; extend the shaft upward to reach the relocated selector. It must read as the same tangible hardware, not a hovering light. Restore the old receiver-head position with the continuous slim vertical shaft. This aligns with the canonical pointing fingertip to be composited later. No creature, crown, text, UI, labels or watermark. Do not change anything else; output same full wide environment.
